description: An optional fine-grained authorization engine RPs can call to delegate domain "can-they" decisions.

requirements.description: An optional policy engine RPC endpoint allows relying parties to delegate domain-specific authorization decisions ('can user X perform action Y on resource Z?'). The engine evaluates the user's roles, scopes, and group memberships against a policy definition stored per realm. Policy definitions are manageable via admin RPC. This offloads fine-grained access decisions from individual RPs to the authenticator.
requirements.deferred_reason: Relying-party policy evaluation remains owned by each consumer; this plan delivers explicit scope claims and local enforcement, not a central policy engine.
requirements.revisit_trigger: Two or more relying parties need a shared resource-level authorization policy service.
requirements.title: Delegated Authorization and Fine-Grained Policy Engine

validation.notes: api/internal/policy/policy_test.go: define a policy allowing role R to perform action A on resource type T; evaluate for user with role R → allowed; evaluate for user without role R → denied

api/handlers/policy/policy_e2e_test.go: define policy via admin RPC; call Check RPC with user token, action, and resource → allowed/denied response matches policy; update policy and re-evaluate → new decision applied

title: Delegated Authorization/Policy Engine
